TIANJIN DECENT INTERNATIONAL TRADE CO., LTD. is a professional industrial trading company based in Tianjin, China, backed by many years of experience in the steel and construction materials industry.

With extensive knowledge of steel products, manufacturing, sourcing, quality control, and international trade, we have developed strong relationships with reliable manufacturers and suppliers across China. Our experience enables us to understand the technical and commercial requirements of international buyers and delivering our services and products to their door step that meet the right specifications, quality standards, and project needs.

Tianjin, one of China’s leading industrial and logistics hubs, provides us with an excellent strategic advantage, including direct access to major international shipping routes. From this location, we efficiently serve contractors, distributors, trading companies, and procurement teams in markets around the world.

Our core business is mainly focuses on HR Coils, CR Coils, Pre-Galvanized Coils, Color Coated Steel Coils, Light & Heavy Steel Structural Profiles, Scaffolding Materials, Structural steel components, and related construction products including:
  • • HR Coils (Various thickness)
  • • Pre-Galvanized Coils for Forming materials (Various Thickness)
  • • Structural Steel Profiles
  • • Cup Lock Scaffolding Systems
  • • Ring / Pin Lock Scaffolding Systems
  • • Tube & Fitting Scaffolding
  • • Scaffolding Components and Accessories

Our years of experience in the steel business have taught us that successful international supply is not simply about offering competitive prices. It requires accurate specifications, consistent quality, dependable production, professional communication, and reliable delivery.

At Tianjin Decent, we work closely with every customer to understand the intended application, technical requirements, quantities, standards, and delivery expectations. We then source and coordinate the most suitable products from qualified manufacturing partners.

Our commitment is simple: the right product, the right specification, and reliable supply.
We aim to build long-term partnerships with our customers by combining our steel industry experience, strong sourcing capabilities, technical understanding, and commitment to service.

02 / PRODUCTS

Core product portfolio.

A complete industrial supply catalog — Hot Rolled Coils, Pre-Galvanized & Color Coated Coils, Structural Steel Profiles, and Modular Scaffolding Systems.

01 / Steel Coils

Hot Rolled Steel Coils (HR Coils)

Commercial, structural, and high-strength grades (ASTM A36/A1011, EN 10025, JIS G3131). Thickness 1.2–25 mm, mill or pickled & oiled finish for international engineering.
02 / Forming Coils

Galvanized & Color Coated Coils

Forming grade continuous hot-dip zinc coating (20–275 g/m²) and PPGI RAL color-coated coils (Z40–600 g/m²) for cold-forming, bending, and roofing.
03 / Profiles

Structural Steel Profiles

H-Beams (wide flange), I-Beams, C-Channels, Angle sections, Square/Round bars, and Hollow sections (SHS/RHS/CHS) for building and bridges.
04 / Pipes

Seamless Industrial Pipes

Fluid, gas, and oil pipes conforming to API Spec 5L / GB standards. Schedule 40 to 120, black galvanized coated in 6 m, 6.4 m, and 12 m lengths.
05 / Scaffolding

Cup Lock & Ring Lock Systems

Modular access and shoring systems with single-node wedge connection and rosette attachments for fast erection and high load capacity.

07 / QUALITY

Specification is the standard.

Product quality in industrial trading begins with precise specification and consistent sourcing. Our approach ensures that products are supplied to the stated specification — material grade, dimensional tolerance, surface treatment, and finish.

01
Specification accuracy
